title: The Un-Coordinate Void

features.name: the-gridline-end
features.desc-on-touch: Where the last coordinate was written and then erased. The highway marked this point: STOP. Beyond this, the archive has no names for directions. You stand in a space without coordinates, and it holds you perfectly.

features.name: the-motion-stopped
features.desc-on-touch: Every moving thing that reached here became still. Not frozen, but present. The archive feels their presence: each thing that crossed the grid line and then stayed, learning how to be without getting anywhere.

features.name: the-blank-register
features.desc-on-touch: A ledger that has never been written in. The archive tries to record position and bearing here, but the pen finds no grid to mark. The whiteness itself is the entry.

features.name: the-presence-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Where being is enough. Not motion, not location—just the fact of being here, in a place the maps can no longer name. You dip into it and find yourself more present than ever before.

inscription: where the highway learned that arrival is the only coordinate that matters

file.name: Final_Highway_Log_End_of_Route.txt
file.note: The last entry: coordinates stop. The final words: 'I am here. The grid is done. The being is enough.'

exits.label: back north to where the grid still insists on direction
into the further void where even presence dissolves
toward where the void learns it has a name after all

reverie.title: REVERIE — where the road finally said enough
narr: You stood with Katita where the highway ended.
The grid-line was painted here: STOP. She looked at
the blank land ahead. 'No more coordinates,' she
said. Leif joined you, and none of you moved. Not
lost, not stopped—just present, in a place that had
run out of words for where you were. That was enough.
